label: MAKE IT OBVIOUS
head: Gym bag by the door
sub: Pack it the night before. Morning you just picks it up.

label: MAKE IT EASY
head: Start in under 2 minutes
sub: Meal prep on your day off. Savings move on payday by themselves.

label: MAKE IT ATTRACTIVE
head: Best podcast is treadmill only
sub: Pair the thing you need with the thing you crave.

head: Where your phone sleeps
r: You stand up to kill the alarm

head: Make bad habits hard to reach

label: NEVER MISS TWICE
head: Check off habits every night
sub: Missing once is life. Missing twice is a new habit.

text: Disciplined guys don't have more willpower. They *need less of it.*
